g.title: GS_INV
g.text: • same input + same ruleset = same provisional result
• confirmed historic decisions are immutable; regrade creates a new evaluation
• clinician-only branches stop for reviewer confirmation
• national clinical route stays separate from local booking priority

g.title: DES_REG
g.text: Applicable regular interval after specialist confirmation

g.title: IMM_PROV
g.text: Record classifier, evidence, date, rationale, specialist input
and whether immune status was sent on laboratory request

g.title: IMM_NO
g.text: Not immune deficient on this fact alone
Use ordinary interval unless another indication
